text:
96 PRs merged this week. Agents got a workspace, a shell, and more room to think. Media models are increasingly using the same paths across Chat and Responses. Under the floorboards: stream validation, cache recovery, better fallbacks, clearer provider errors, and a more precise model catalog.

The garden remains extremely busy. 🌱🐝

Details live in the repo: github.com/pollinations/pollinations
